# AION Veritas

> Pre-open probability bands for Indian indices. Information, never instruction.

AION Veritas publishes a daily pre-open probability band for NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY,
and SENSEX, by 08:55 IST, and validates it publicly the same afternoon against the
09:15-09:25 median opening window. It reports a range and a separate directional
lean. It is not a trade signal, not a price prediction, and not investment advice.
Hits and misses are both published on a permanent, crawlable validation record.

Stance: informs, never instructs — a guiding light, not a guiding hand. A range to
position around, never a call to act.

## Facts

- Product: AION Veritas
- Coverage: NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, SENSEX (index-level only)
- Published: by 08:55 IST each trading day
- Validated: same afternoon, against the 09:15-09:25 IST median opening window
- Calibration: an 80% calibrated range; past calibration does not guarantee future
  coverage
- Access: paid subscription, no free tier (Single Index or All Indices)
- Owner: AION Analytics (India), founded by Lokesh Gupta
- Not affiliated with Aion Analytics LLC (US) or AION Labs (Israel)
- Prediction methodology: proprietary and patent-adjacent, undisclosed

## Canonical URLs

- Product: https://dashboard.aiondashboard.site/veritas
- Public validation receipts: https://dashboard.aiondashboard.site/veritas/validation
- Technical model page: https://dashboard.aiondashboard.site/models/veritas

## Disclaimer

Educational and research purposes only. Not investment advice. AION is not a
SEBI-registered RA or IA. Trading involves substantial risk. SEBI regulations apply.
Past performance is not indicative of future results.
